title: Machine learning-guided discovery of thermophilic carbonic anhydrases
summary: AdaBoost and LightGBM classifiers applied to sequence descriptors prioritized three gamma carbonic anhydrases from Fang Hot Spring metagenomic data. The recombinant enzymes showed carbonic anhydrase activity and melting temperatures from 97.0 to 109.1 °C in the reported assays. Some candidates are similar to annotated proteins; the contribution is discovery and testing of thermostable enzymes, not new protein families or demonstrated industrial performance.
organization: National Center for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology; Mahidol University; Thammasat University
